proof.title: Nō hea ēnei tau
proof.subtitle: Nā Cloudflare i ine, ehara nā tēnei whārangi
proof.query: Te uiui tika kei muri i te tūtohi
proof.openRaw: Te whakautu a Cloudflare kāore i pāngia
proof.edge: Ka haere ia tono ki dehub.io mā Cloudflare i mua i tōna taenga ki ā mātou tūmau. Ko ēnei tatauranga te whakahiatotanga a Cloudflare anō o taua waka — ko ngā tau ōrite e whakaatuhia ana e tā mātou papatohu. Ehara i te tuhinga i tō pūtirotiro e kohi ana, nō reira kāore he mea i tēnei whārangi e taea ai te whakanui, ā, kāore te ārai kaiwhaiwhai e whakarerekē ana.
proof.live: Ka pānui ora te whārangi i a rātou. Mā te uta i te /stats ka karangatia tā mātou pito, ka uiui atu ki te Analytics API a Cloudflare i taua wā tonu, ka penapena i te whakautu mō te 60 hēkona.
proof.limits: He aha tā tēnei e whakaatu ai, he aha tāna kāore: ka kite koe ka puta ngā tau mai i te whakahiatotanga a Cloudflare, ehara i tā mātou waehere taupānga, ā, ko te uiui i whakaputaina i konei ko te mea e rere ana. Ehara i te mea kāore he whakawhirinaki — kei a mātou te tohu API, ā, kāore a Cloudflare e tuku pānui tūmatanui mō ngā wetewete o tētahi rohe. Ko te tangata e whai rohe Cloudflare ana ka taea e ia te whakahaere i te uiui ōrite me te whakaū i tōna āhua.

definitions.title: He aha te tikanga o ēnei tau
definitions.visitors: — ngā wāhitau IP motuhake i kitea e Cloudflare i taua rā. E tata ana ki te tangata, engari ehara i te mea ōrite: ka tatauria kotahi te tari kei runga i te hononga kotahi, ā, ka tatauria rua te waea e huri ana i waenga i te wifi me te raraunga pūkoro.
definitions.pageViews: — ngā tono e whakarōpūtia ana e Cloudflare hei utanga whārangi, ehara i te whakaahua, tuhinga, karanga API rānei.
definitions.bots: — he tatauranga mata ēnei i te tapa, nō reira kei roto ngā kaikawe, ngā aroturuki wāhi mahi me ngā kiritaki tuhinga. Ka kite koe i a rātou i te wehewehenga pūtirotiro i runga ake nei, kei reira ngā tāurunga pēnā i "Curl" me "Kāore i te mōhiotia" he waka aunoa, ehara i te tangata. Hei tātari i ngā pūrehe me whai mahere Cloudflare utu kāore i a mātou, ā, ki te tangohia puku he whakatau tata ka iti ake te taea o ngā tau te tirotiro, kaua e nui ake.
definitions.total: — ka tāpiritia ngā tirohanga whārangi me ngā tono puta noa i te whānuitanga. Kāore ngā tatauranga manuhiri e tāpiritia ana ki te "tapeke manuhiri", nā te mea ko te tangata i konei i te Rāhina me te Rātū ka taua rua.
definitions.peak: — ko te tatauranga motuhake teitei rawa i tētahi wāhanga kotahi o te whānuitanga, mō te take ōrite: he tau e inea tūturutia ana e Cloudflare, ehara i te mea i hangaia mā te tāpiri i ngā tatauranga e taupatupatu ana.
definitions.resolutionTerm: Ka mutu ngā raraunga ā-haora i te 3 rā
definitions.resolution: — koinā te tepe a Cloudflare i tēnei mahere, ehara i te kōwhiringa: ka whakakāhoretia e ia ngā uiui ā-haora nui ake i te toru rā. He ā-haora ngā tirohanga 24 haora me te 3 rā; he ā-rā te 7 rā me te roa ake, ā, kāore he huarahi hei tā tūtohi ā-haora mō te wā katoa.
definitions.breakdown: — ka whai ēnei i te whānuitanga i tīpakohia e koe, engari ki ngā rā {{max}} anake ki muri, koirā te roa e puritia ai te wehewehenga ia rā. I ngā whānuitanga roa ake ka kapi te tūtohi i te wā nui ake i te rārangi whenua.
definitions.start: — ko te "wā katoa" te tikanga ko ia rā e puritia tonutia ana e Cloudflare, i tēnei rā ko ngā rā {{days}} mai i te {{date}}, te rā i neke ai a dehub.io ki Cloudflare. Kāore he raraunga tapa o mua hei whakaatu, ā, ka taka ngā rā tawhito i te wā e whakakoroheketia ana e Cloudflare.

superpowers.title: SuperPowers
superpowers.intro: He nui ake i te whakaahua i te taha o tō ingoa tā te pī e hoko ai. Ia rua wiki, ka whakawhiwhia ngā hikinga e ia — mā ia hikinga e tuku ai he pānui ki te wāhi runga rawa o te tahua kāinga. Tekau mā toru ngā taumata, tekau mā toru ngā mana, kotahi te mea ka wātea ia pikitanga.
superpowers.boostExplainer: Ka tuku i tēnei pānui ki te wāhi runga rawa o te tahua kāinga i tō wā kua whakaritea.
superpowers.secondWindExplainer: Neke atu i te wiki te pakeke o tēnei pānui. Mā te Manawa Tuarua e whakahoki ki te wāhi runga rawa o te tahua.
superpowers.shareOfVoice: Ka huri haere te wāhi hikinga. Ki te maha ngā hikinga e rere ana i te wā kotahi, ka whakawhiwhia he kaimātakitaki ki tētahi, kua kōwhiria mā te taumaha o te taumata pī — he maha ake ngā wā ka whakaatuhia te taumata teitei ake, ā, ka whiwhi ia tangata i te wā i whakaritea mōna.
